dedupe_keys.name: impianti di depurazione delle acque reflue urbane

description: ISPAT, Autonomous Province of Trento, publishes counts of urban wastewater-treatment plants that provide secondary or advanced treatment. The stated coverage is 2005 to 2022, with comparisons for Trentino, South Tyrol, Veneto, North-East Italy, Lombardy, northern Italy and Italy. ISPAT processes ISTAT source data into this structural indicator and offers JSON and CSV distributions. Access is free under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. Plant counts can supply infrastructure-stock constraints or comparison values in wastewater-service capacity-planning studies, but they do not measure treatment throughput or service capacity. The source identifies a stock indicator and date range; observation intervals and missing years were not verified from the data. Related provincial plant-list metadata describes individual facilities, while this resource contains territorial totals. It is not treated as an independent replacement for all upstream ISTAT statistics, and the files were not downloaded.
